grammar.topic: Future time clauses (when, as soon as, before, after, until)
explainTr: Gelecekten bahsederken 'when, as soon as, before, after, until' gibi bağlaçlardan sonra will kullanmayız; Present Simple kullanırız. Ana cümlede ise will gelir: I will call you when I arrive.
Zaman cümleciği başta da gelebilir, sonda da. Başta gelirse virgül koyarsın: As soon as she signs, she will start. Sonda gelirse virgül gerekmez: She will start as soon as she signs.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'geldiğimde ararım' dersin: 'geldiğimde' şimdiki-geniş gibi kurulur. İngilizcede de benzer: 'when I arrive' (will arrive değil). Türkler genelde 'when I will arrive' hatası yapar, bunu dikkatle ayır.
table: When I arrive, I will call.
As soon as she signs, she will start.
I will eat before I leave.
After he finishes, he will go home.
I will wait until you come.

examples.en: When I arrive at school, I will call you.
As soon as she signs the contract, she will start work.

Before you leave, you will get your badge.

exercises.q: I will call you when I ___ at school.
exercises.whyTr: When ile gelecek zaman cümleciğinde Present Simple kullanılır, will kullanılmaz.

exercises.q: As soon as Hafsa ___ the contract, she will start work.
exercises.whyTr: 'As soon as' sonrası Present Simple; Hafsa üçüncü tekil kişi: signs.

exercises.q: Before the students ___, I will write the plan on the board.
exercises.whyTr: 'Before' sonrası gelecek için Present Simple: come.

exercises.answer: I will call you as soon as I finish
exercises.whyTr: Ana cümle will ile, zaman cümleciği Present Simple ile kurulur.

exercises.q: She will wait until the principal ___.
exercises.whyTr: 'Until' sonrası Present Simple; the principal tekil: arrives.

options: When Emre gets home, we will have dinner.
When Emre will get home, we will have dinner.
When Emre gets home, we have will dinner.
When Emre got home, we will have dinner.
exercises.whyTr: When'den sonra will gelmez; gets home doğrudur.

exercises.q: After she ___ the orientation, she will meet her supervisor.
exercises.whyTr: 'After' ile gelecek için Present Simple: finishes.

exercises.answer: When I get my badge I will send you a photo
exercises.whyTr: When cümleciği Present Simple, ana cümle will + fiil.

exercises.q: I won't leave ___ the students are safe.
By the time she started the new job, she ___ the training.
exercises.whyTr: Geçmişte bir andan önce biten iş: Past Perfect.

exercises.q: As soon as I get my first paycheck, I ___ buy a new bag.

exercises.whyTr: 'So far' ile Present Perfect; Hafsa tekil: has had.

reading.title: Hafsa's first week
reading.text:
Hafsa got the job! Next Monday she will go to orientation at the district office. Before she starts, she has a long list of things to do, and Emre is helping her make a plan.

"First, you have to sign the contract," Emre says. "When you sign it, the district will send you a welcome email." Hafsa nods. She has read the contract twice. The salary is not very high, but she will also get some benefits, and she is happy about that.

On Monday, a supervisor named Ms. Rivera will meet the new staff. As soon as everyone arrives, she will explain the school policies. Then the group will go over the main procedures: how to take attendance, how to call the front office, and what to do in an emergency. After orientation ends, each person will get a handbook and a staff badge.

Hafsa is a little worried about her English. "What will I do if I don't understand something?" she asks. Emre smiles. "You will ask a colleague. Before you leave home, put a small notepad in your bag. When you hear a new word, write it down."

Linda also has advice. "As soon as you meet your colleagues, introduce yourself and smile. Teachers always help new people. When you feel nervous, remember that your responsibility is just to do your best." Hafsa feels better. This evening she will pack her bag, and every night this week she will practice her introduction until it sounds natural.

questions.q: When will the district send Hafsa a welcome email?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'When you sign it, the district will send you a welcome email.'

questions.q: What will Ms. Rivera do as soon as everyone arrives?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'As soon as everyone arrives, she will explain the school policies.'

questions.q: What will each person get after orientation ends?
options: A handbook and a staff badge
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'each person will get a handbook and a staff badge.'

questions.q: What does Emre tell Hafsa to do when she hears a new word?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'When you hear a new word, write it down.'

listening.title: A call about the first day

script.speaker: Ms. Rivera
script.text: Hello, Hafsa. This is Ms. Rivera from the district. I'm calling about your first day.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Hello, Ms. Rivera. Thank you for calling.

script.speaker: Ms. Rivera
script.text: Please arrive at eight thirty. When you get there, go to the front office and ask for me.

script.speaker: Ms. Rivera
script.text: Bring your ID and the signed contract. As soon as I see them, I will make your badge.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: And what happens after I get the badge?

script.speaker: Ms. Rivera
script.text: Before the training starts, we will have coffee and meet the other new staff. After lunch, you will visit a classroom.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Will I teach on the first day?

script.speaker: Ms. Rivera
script.text: No, you will just watch. When you feel ready, we will give you a short lesson.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: That sounds good. I will be there on time.

script.speaker: Ms. Rivera
script.text: Great. Call me if you have any questions before Monday.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Thank you very much. See you soon.

questions.whyTr: Ms. Rivera: 'Please arrive at eight thirty.'

options: Her ID and the signed contract
questions.whyTr: Ms. Rivera: 'Bring your ID and the signed contract.'

questions.q: What will Ms. Rivera do as soon as she sees the papers?
questions.whyTr: Ms. Rivera: 'As soon as I see them, I will make your badge.'

questions.q: Will Hafsa teach on the first day?
options: No, she will watch a classroom.
questions.whyTr: Ms. Rivera: 'No, you will just watch.'

writing.promptTr: İlk iş gününü planla: when, as soon as, before, after ve until ile 6-8 cümle yaz (80-120 kelime).
writing.promptEn: Write about your plans for your first day at work. Use when, as soon as, before, after and until.
frames: As soon as I get to school, I will ...
Before the training starts, I will ...
When I meet my colleagues, I will ...
writing.model: On my first day, I will wake up early. As soon as I get to school, I will go to the front office and ask for Ms. Rivera. Before the training starts, I will introduce myself to my new colleagues. When I get my badge, I will wear it all day. After the first week ends, I will write down new words and practice them at home. I will not worry until I really have a problem. When I feel ready, I will teach my first lesson.
checklistTr: When / as soon as / before / after / until'den sonra 'will' kullanmadın mı?
Ana cümlede will + yalın fiil var mı?
En az üç farklı zaman bağlacı kullandın mı?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?

examSet.q:
Tom starts a new job on Monday. As soon as he arrives, he will meet his supervisor. After that, he will get a badge, and before lunch he will visit the classrooms.

What will Tom do before lunch?
examSet.whyTr: Metin: 'before lunch he will visit the classrooms.'

examSet.q:
Nina is a substitute teacher. When a teacher is sick, the school calls her early in the morning. As soon as she gets the call, she checks the sub plan on her phone. She leaves home after she eats breakfast.

What does Nina do as soon as she gets the call?
examSet.whyTr: Metin: 'As soon as she gets the call, she checks the sub plan.'
